name: fastly-mcp
description: Manage Fastly services with a local MCP server

interface.longDescription:
Manage Fastly services with a local MCP server.
Ask it to list your services, check traffic and usage, or review domains, backends, and TLS settings.
It can also purge cached content and update service settings, dictionaries, and access control lists.

You'll need a Fastly account and an API token with permission to access the resources you want to work with.
A read-only token lets your assistant inspect resources; a token with write access can also allow changes and deletions in production.

The server runs on your computer and requires Bun or Node.js 24.12.0 or newer.
See the README for setup instructions.
